title: Cloud console usability study
notes: Usability study with a researcher from a cloud provider. I do hands-on tasks in their console while thinking aloud; the researcher asks questions now and then.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Hi, thanks for joining today. Can you hear me okay?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Great. Today you'll do a few tasks in our console while thinking aloud. There are no right or wrong answers, we're testing the product, not you.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Before we start, could you tell me a bit about your role and what you work on?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Sure. I'm a machine learning engineer at a health startup.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Nice. And tell me how you use cloud GPUs for fine-tuning today.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Okay, let's start task one. Please create a new project and set its default region.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Okay. Hmm, where is the region setting? Oh, here, it's under project settings.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Thanks. How did you feel about task one? Anything particularly good or bad?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: And how big is the team you work with day to day?
